tasks.title: Rename the flag and the config field across the CLI
tasks.description: Add `checkout` beside `repo` in OhConfig, add the single accessor configCheckout(), route every read site through it, add the --checkout flag with --repo as a silent alias, make both-flags an error, and keep the D-3 image pin reading the renamed field. Covers US-001, US-002, US-003, US-004.
tasks.complexity: Medium-high. Known transformation with decisive checks, but the blast radius crosses four files, three of the reads are the load-bearing ones (entryRepo identity anchor, D-3 pin, materialize base selection), and four files are byte-frozen. Deciding factors: cross-boundary compatibility contract, silent-failure mode on entryRepo.
tasks.selectionReason: Opus is the hardest supported non-Sonnet model available to this dispatch. The task carries a silent-failure mode (entryRepo resolution) that a weaker worker would plausibly miss while still producing green tests.
tasks.searchOutputLimits: Stay inside .agro/cli/src. Do not dump full test output; report failing test names and the assertion text only.
tasks.worktreeIsolation: Shares the task worktree with T2. Their owned write paths are disjoint (.agro/cli/src vs docs+CHANGELOG), and the only shared mutable state is the git index, which is removed from both workers' scope: neither worker runs any git command and the advisor performs every commit.
tasks.continuationMethod: Native continuation via SendMessage; this is the continuing worker for all coupled CLI work including repair rounds.
tasks.deliverable: Edited files in the worktree, uncommitted, plus a report naming each changed file and each new test.
tasks.verification: pnpm test  (expect pass) ; pnpm typecheck (expect pass) ; sha256sum -c on the four frozen files (expect OK)
tasks.stoppingCondition: Tests and typecheck both pass and every US-001..US-004 criterion is met; or a criterion cannot be met without touching an excluded path, in which case stop and report BLOCKED naming the path.
tasks.failureRepairRoute: Failed criterion routes back to T1 via SendMessage; the advisor never edits these files itself.

tasks.title: Update the docs and the changelog
tasks.description: Rewrite docs/installation.md, docs/quickstart.md, and docs/configuration.md to use --checkout and the checkout field, state that --repo and repo remain supported aliases, keep AGRO_REPO_DIR unrenamed, and add a Changed entry to CHANGELOG.md under Unreleased. Covers US-005.
tasks.complexity: Low-medium. Mechanical prose transformation with a decisive check (/ste). The advisor supplies the exact help-text wording as a contract, so it does not depend on T1's output.
tasks.selectionReason: Opus per the operator preference that a low-complexity worker runs on Opus, and Sonnet is excluded.
tasks.searchOutputLimits: Do not quote whole doc files back; report the changed line ranges.
tasks.worktreeIsolation: Shares the task worktree with T1; see T1's entry for why the shared state is removed rather than duplicated.
tasks.deliverable: Edited docs and CHANGELOG in the worktree, uncommitted, plus a report naming each changed file and line range.
tasks.verification: /ste checker over the changed prose (expect clean) ; grep confirms AGRO_REPO_DIR still present in docs/configuration.md ; grep confirms each of the three docs states the alias
tasks.stoppingCondition: All three docs and the changelog updated and the /ste checker is clean; or the checker cannot be located, in which case report the gap rather than skipping silently.
tasks.failureRepairRoute: Failed criterion routes back to T2 via SendMessage.
